timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, I'm Deborah Guy-Mire, Director of Prenatal Plus Yoga here in Coral Gables, Florida.

Basically, dealing with pregnancy birth and beyond, dealing with the wonderful time of pregnancy, where women stay fit, physically, emotionally, spiritually, and just helping them feel comfortable and enjoy their nine months of pregnancy.
I see hundreds of moms during the week and they absolutely, the ones that need the benefit and purchase the benefit have greatly, greatly benefited from the physical alleviation of discomfort.

With the postpartum moms, usually the bellafit postpartum girdles are worn right after they give birth and this has been an extreme benefit to helping moms bring the abdominal muscles back together and make them feel so much better about their bodies coming back to pre-primacy size after birth.
The first time I've had a child birth, even with C-section, it's been wonderful to help them keep those abdominal muscles and the uterus intact.
I am a certified childbirth educator, so I do spend a lot of time educating women and couples, helping them to prepare for labor and birth and working with them after birth with the babies.
I'm a certified dola and childbirth educator.
Pre-nado plus yoga is Miami specialty center for pregnancy birth and beyond. We're located in the heart of coral bables.
It's www.pre-nadoplusyoga.com. I'm Deborah, directorist and look us up. We have a great time with pregnancy birth and beyond.
